title: Intelligence Authorization Act for Fiscal Year 2027
last_action: The Senate Intelligence Committee reported the measure and placed it on the Senate calendar.
summary: Title VII, sections 701–711, addresses AI exploitation and intelligence sharing, targeting review, testing standards, incident tracking, agentic-system access controls, AI Security Center duties, targeting-output labeling, escalation research, adversarial-AI interaction, proliferation and export assessments, the Vulnerabilities Equities Process, and prohibited models.
committee_dynamics: The mature AI-security title can move with the intelligence authorization itself or be merged into NDAA. Armed Services and Intelligence jurisdiction must be reconciled in the endgame.
